jobs.occupation: Lastbilchauffør (C/CE) / Truck Driver (C/CE)– Stabrand Spedition, Nordhavn
jobs.description:
Lastbilchauffører søges til Stabrand Spedition i Nordhavn

Vi søger flere lastbilchauffører til vores kørselsafdeling med udgangspunkt fra Skagerrakvej 8, 2150 Nordhavn.

Hos Stabrand Spedition får du en hverdag, hvor dagene ikke nødvendigvis ligner hinanden. Vi kører både stykgods, part loads, full loads samt skibscontainere på chassis og med sideloader, primært på Sjælland.

Du får som udgangspunkt fast tilknyttet bil, som du har ansvar for i det daglige. Du bliver samtidig en del af et godt chaufførteam, hvor man hjælper hinanden, taler ordentligt sammen og har tæt kontakt med vores disponenter.

Arbejdsdagen

Arbejdsdagen starter normalt omkring kl. 06.00-06.30 i Nordhavn.

Opgaverne varierer efter, hvad der skal køres den pågældende dag. Det kan være stykgods den ene dag, part- eller full load den næste og containerkørsel en tredje.

Derudover følger de almindelige chaufføropgaver selvfølgelig med: af- og pålæsning, lastsikring, håndtering af trailer og containere, dokumenter samt almindelig kontrol og pasning af bilen og udstyret.

Vi leder efter dig, der er mødestabil, tager ansvar for dit arbejde og kan arbejde selvstændigt. Du skal passe ordentligt på bilen og materiellet og være indstillet på, at planen nogle gange ændrer sig i løbet af dagen.

Som chauffør er du ofte den person fra Stabrand Spedition, som vores kunder møder. Derfor betyder det også noget for os, at du er ordentlig i din omgang med kunderne og repræsenterer virksomheden på en god måde.

Engelsk er et krav. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke nødvendigt.

Har du erfaring med containerkørsel, stykgods eller anden godskørsel, er det selvfølgelig en fordel.

Kørekort og certifikater

Når du søger, vil vi gerne have et klart overblik over, hvad du har af kørekort og beviser.

·   dine kørekortkategorier og udløbsdato

·   eventuelt chaufføruddannelsesbevis / EU-kvalifikationsbevis og udløbsdato

·   førerkort til digital takograf og udløbsdato

·   eventuelt ADR-bevis

·   eventuelt krancertifikat

·   andre relevante certifikater eller uddannelser

ADR og krancertifikat er en fordel, men ikke et krav til alle vores opgaver.

Hvad får du hos os?

Du får en fuldtidsstilling med udgangspunkt i Nordhavn, primært kørsel på Sjælland, forskellige typer transportopgaver og en fast tilknyttet bil.

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed, hvor transport hænger tæt sammen med vores terminal-, lager- og 3PL-aktiviteter. Det giver en hverdag med mange forskellige typer opgaver og korte veje mellem chauffører, disponenter og resten af organisationen.

Ansøgning

Send os en kort ansøgning eller præsentation af dig selv sammen med dit CV på tobias@stabrand.dk eller ring på 39209030 for spørgsmål vedrørende stillingen.

Husk at angive dine kørekortkategorier, udløbsdatoer og relevante certifikater.

Vi indkalder løbende relevante kandidater til samtale.

***ENGLISH BELOW***

Truck Drivers Wanted for Stabrand Spedition in Nordhavn

We are looking for additional truck drivers to join our transport department, based at Skagerrakvej 8, 2150 Nordhavn.

At Stabrand Spedition, no two days are necessarily the same. We handle groupage, part loads, full loads and shipping containers on chassis and sideloaders, mainly across Zealand.

As a general rule, you will have a truck assigned to you and be responsible for it in your day-to-day work. You will also join a good team of drivers where people help each other, communicate properly and work closely with our dispatchers.

The working day

The working day normally starts around 06:00-06:30 in Nordhavn.

The jobs vary depending on what needs to be transported that day. One day may involve groupage, the next a part or full load, and another day container transport.

The usual driver duties are naturally part of the job as well: loading and unloading, securing cargo, handling trailers and containers, paperwork, and normal daily checks and care of the truck and equipment.

We are looking for someone who turns up on time, takes responsibility for the job and is comfortable working independently. You should take good care of the truck and equipment and be prepared for plans to change during the day from time to time.

As a driver, you are often the person from Stabrand Spedition our customers meet. It therefore matters to us that you deal with customers properly and represent the company in a professional and positive way.

English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience with container transport, groupage or other types of goods transport is an advantage.

Driving licence and certificates

When applying, please give us a clear overview of your driving licence and certificates.

·   your driving licence categories and expiry date

·   any driver qualification card / EU Certificate of Professional Competence and expiry date

·   digital tachograph driver card and expiry date

·   any ADR certificate

·   any crane certificate

·   other relevant certificates or qualifications

ADR and crane certificates are an advantage, but they are not required for all of our assignments.

What we offer

This is a full-time position based in Nordhavn, with driving mainly across Zealand, a varied mix of transport assignments and, a truck assigned to you only.

You will join a company where transport works closely together with our terminal, warehouse and 3PL activities. This creates a varied working day and short lines of communication between drivers, dispatchers and the rest of the organisation.

Application

Send us a short application or introduction together with your CV to tobias@stabrand.dk or contact us via +45 39209030 for questions regarding the position.

Please remember to include your driving licence categories, expiry dates and relevant certificates.

We invite suitable candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

As a Team Leader, you will be responsible for a team of 3-5 employees and ensure that daily tasks are planned and carried out efficiently, safely, and to a high standard of quality. You should be able to lead by example, motivate team members, and contribute to a positive working environment.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead and coordinate a team of 3-5 employees.

· Plan and allocate daily work tasks.

· Train and mentor new employees.

· Ensure compliance with all relevant safety regulations and quality standards.

· Actively participate in demolition work on construction sites.

· Maintain ongoing communication with management, clients, and business partners.

· Ensure the correct use of tools, machinery, and personal protective equipment (PPE).

Qualifications

· Previous experience supervising employees and managing work sites.

· Ability to work independently and take responsibility.

· Strong planning, organizational, and teamwork skills.

· Valid Category B driving licence.

· Knowledge of occupational health and safety regulations, safety procedures, and the use of personal protective equipment.

· Asbestos removal certification is an advantage.

We Offer

· A permanent full-time position.

· Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

· Opportunities for professional development and further training.

· A positive work environment with skilled colleagues.

· Exciting and varied projects.

jobs.occupation: Regional Director – Nordics & Baltics | Successful International Group
jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client is a successful international distributor of specialty chemicals, with operations across a number of international markets and a presence in more than 20 countries.

The group holds a strong international position and is currently working to strengthen its presence and drive further growth in the Nordics and Baltics.

You will become a pivotal part of an international organization, with excellent opportunities to influence development and shape the direction of future commercial growth.

About the Position

As Regional Director – Nordics & Baltics, you will have overall responsibility for the business unit's development, performance, and future direction in the region.

Your primary task will be to set the strategic direction and ensure the continuous development of the business. You will play a central role in translating the group's ambitions into concrete goals and results, as well as creating the organizational and commercial framework for future growth.

In close collaboration with the Sales Director, you will develop and implement the strategy for the region and ensure progress through clear leadership, prioritization, and strong cooperation with the rest of the organization.

You will establish direction and engagement within the organization, develop leaders and employees, and ensure that the right competencies and resources are brought into play. The role requires the ability to deliver results through others while maintaining a strategic overview and an understanding of the business's commercial opportunities.

Your Primary Responsibilities

• Develop leaders and employees with a focus on competencies, engagement, accountability, and collaboration.

• Translate the group's overall ambitions into concrete strategies, goals, and action plans.

• Support a company culture characterized by initiative, ownership, openness, and continuous development.

About You

You have leadership experience and a strong strategic understanding. You possess the ability to gain commitment, set direction, and develop an organization through clear leadership, involvement, and trust.

You do not necessarily need to have held a director-level position previously. The most important thing is that you have the ambition, the strategic overview, and the ability to take overall responsibility for a business unit's development and results.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience in commercial leadership and organizational development, including developing and implementing strategies and translating them into concrete goals and results.

• Are a clear leader who sets direction, builds engagement, and ensures progress.

• Thrive with overall responsibility and are able to maintain both the strategic overview and an understanding of the organization's daily operations.

• Are a modern leader who believes in freedom with responsibility and is motivated by coaching and facilitating rather than micromanaging.

• Have experience in developing people and achieving results through others.

• Possess a good financial understanding and the ability to make decisions on a sound strategic and financial basis.

• Have experience from the specialty chemicals industry or related sectors. This will be considered an advantage.

• Communicate effortlessly in both Danish and English. Additional language skills are an advantage.

What Is Offered

• A central leadership position with responsibility for an international business unit that is part of a successful global group.

• A commercial mandate with the opportunity to influence strategy and organization and leave a clear mark on the development of the Nordics and Baltics.

• A dynamic working environment combining strategic responsibility, leadership, and organizational development.

• Business travel in connection with the development of the business in the Nordics and Baltics, with significant influence over your own travel planning.

Workplace: Aarhus area.

You can be based anywhere in Denmark, as there are good opportunities for remote work. If you live outside daily commuting distance, you will be expected to work from the office approximately once a week.

Application

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to upload your CV as soon as possible.

Please upload your CV and, optionally, a short cover letter using the Apply for the Position button.

The job advertisement will be removed once the position has been filled.

All inquiries and applications will, of course, be treated confidentially.

Want to Know More?

You are welcome to contact Carsten Lindberg Hartvigsen by phone at +45 41 81 34 00 if you have any questions regarding the position.

If you have any questions, please contact

carsten@lindberghr.dk

Ambu A/S is looking for a Senior Portfolio Management Consultant to join the Innovation PMO.

You will work with complex, cross-functional topics related to portfolio management, governance and business performance. Your role is to define the problem, build the fact base, align stakeholders, recommend solutions and establish ownership for implementation.

Reporting to the Director, Innovation PMO, you will work closely with colleagues across the PMO and senior stakeholders across Ambu.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

Key responsibilities

• 
Cross-functional initiatives

• 
Drive selected cross-functional topics from problem definition through analysis, recommendation and stakeholder alignment.

• 
Define decisions, actions and ownership, and hand over execution to the relevant business owner.

• 
Portfolio governance and ways of working

• 
Evaluate and improve processes for project portfolio prioritization, resource management, project governance and performance follow-up.

• 
Translate business goals and requirements and input from subject-matter experts into clear processes, roles, decision criteria and governance.

• 
Analysis and decision support

• 
Analyse portfolio, project, resource and business-performance information to identify issues and recommend actions.

• 
Develop scenarios, recommendations and decision material for senior management.

• 
Management support

• 
Take ownership of selected analyses and cross-functional topics on behalf of the Director, Innovation PMO.

• 
Prepare recommendations, presentation material and follow up agreed actions with relevant stakeholders.

Suggested candidate profile

**Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have relevant experience within project portfolio management, management consulting, PMO, business transformation or operational excellence.

• Have taken complex, cross-functional business problems from initial question to analysis, recommendation and agreed action.

• Have aligned senior stakeholders across functions, including situations with different priorities and no direct reporting relationship.

• Have hands-on experience with portfolio management, prioritization, governance, resource management and/or performance reporting.

• Have prepared analyses, decision recommendations and presentation material for senior management.

• Can work independently with loosely defined assignments, while knowing when to involve subject-matter experts and decision-makers.

• Communicate clearly and concisely in English, both in writing and presentations.

Experience from MedTech or another regulated industry is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Help grow Awaze’s commercial footprint across Germany, Austria and Switzerland by building high-performing travel agency relationships and strategic partnerships that bring our holidays to even more guests.

**Your mission

**As our new Senior Partnership Account Manager, your mission is to grow Awaze’s commercial footprint across the DACH region through two interconnected areas: developing our travel agency channel and building strategic commercial partnerships.

As you’ll be working directly with travel agencies and partners across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you’ll need to be fluent in German, at native or near-native level, as well as confident communicating professionally in English.

You’ll own and grow relationships with travel agencies across the region, lead agencies through the transition from legacy booking systems to Awaze’s modern platform, and identify new opportunities to expand our network. Alongside this, you’ll develop strategic partnerships from initial prospecting and negotiation through to onboarding and ongoing account development.

Working closely with Marketing, Product, Commercial and leadership teams, you’ll use market insight and performance data to strengthen partner engagement, extend Awaze’s reach and deliver measurable commercial impact.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Own and develop relationships with travel agencies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with a particular focus on chains and networks.

• Lead the end-to-end transition of agencies from legacy booking systems to Awaze’s modern platform, including change management, training and onboarding.

• Identify, develop and onboard new travel agency partners, maintaining a strong pipeline of prospective agencies.

• Proactively identify, pursue, negotiate and close new strategic commercial partnerships across the DACH region.

• Manage the full partnership lifecycle, from initial outreach and commercial negotiation through to onboarding and ongoing account development.

• Monitor agency and partnership performance, using data and commercial metrics to identify opportunities for increased adoption, engagement and growth.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to ensure partners are effectively supported and positioned for success.

• Identify co-marketing and co-branding opportunities that create mutual value and extend Awaze’s reach and brand presence.

• Act as a source of DACH market intelligence, sharing relevant trends, partner feedback and commercial insights with leadership and product teams.

• Travel regularly across the DACH region to build and strengthen relationships with agencies and strategic partners.

**Who We’re Looking For

**You’ll thrive in this role if you’re a natural relationship builder who enjoys turning commercial opportunities into long-term, mutually valuable partnerships. You’re comfortable taking ownership of a varied portfolio, confident working independently and equally at home discussing performance data, negotiating a new partnership or helping an established agency embrace a new way of working.

Fluent German, at native or near-native level, is an essential requirement for this role. You’ll use German regularly to build trusted relationships and communicate effectively with travel agencies and strategic partners across the DACH region.

**We’re Looking For Someone Who Brings

**

• Several years of experience in account management, partnerships or business development, ideally within travel, hospitality or a related sector.

• A demonstrable track record of growing accounts and closing partnerships that deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

• Fluent German, at native or near-native level, alongside strong professional English, both written and spoken.

• Strong relationship-building, communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage agency owners, commercial partners and senior stakeholders.

• Strong analytical capabilities and confidence using performance data and commercial metrics to inform decisions and identify opportunities.

• An understanding of brand and marketing principles and the ability to represent Awaze consistently with external partners.

• A self-motivated and structured approach, with the ability to independently manage a large and varied account portfolio.

• Willingness and ability to travel regularly across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, as well as other locations when required.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**

• Successfully transition and onboard travel agencies onto Awaze’s modern platform, driving strong adoption and engagement.

• Grow the number, quality and performance of active travel agency relationships across the DACH region.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective agencies and strategic partners, progressing opportunities through to successful commercial agreements.

• Strengthen retention, satisfaction and commercial performance across your agency and partnership portfolio.

• Turn performance data into clear insights and recommendations that help both our partners and internal teams make better commercial decisions.

**Why you’ll want to work at Awaze

You’ll be part of an international company that invests in the future, and join a dynamic, fast-paced department with skilled and committed colleagues who support each other.

We’re a People-first Business - And We Know That Our Success Starts With Our Teams. Here’s a Glimpse Of What You’ll Enjoy

• Generous discounts on holidays across our brands

• Flexible hybrid working – with the autonomy to work how you work best

• Real opportunities to grow, learn and shape your role as well as careers progression vertically or horizontally, cross countries and responsibilities.

**About Awaze

**Our mission is clear - to create amazing holidays with Europe’s widest choice of holiday homes.

With more than 110,000 properties across Europe, we are the largest managed vacation rentals business in the region. Our ambition is not only to be the biggest, but the best provider of holiday homes in Europe.

As travel continues to evolve, we are focused on what comes next. We will keep strengthening our relationships with guests and homeowners, continuously improving the way we work, and delivering strong performance. By making things simpler and smarter, we are building a business that is ready for what’s next - powered by proud, passionate and inclusive people.

**Worth knowing

**

**What’s next?

At Struers, we help companies and laboratories around the world understand their materials and make confident decisions about quality. Our purpose is Ensuring Certainty, and behind the equipment that delivers that certainty is increasingly sophisticated software.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to help develop the machine-control software behind our next generation of products.

Our machine-control platform is based on modern PLC technology, but this is not a traditional PLC programming role. We approach machine control as a software engineering discipline, applying principles such as structured architecture, modularity, reuse, design patterns, automated testing, and maintainable code.

Whether your background is embedded software, automation, control engineering, C/C++, C#, or PLC development, we are interested in strong software engineers who enjoy making software interact with the physical world.

You will contribute from early concepts through product launch, developing reusable software components, machine behavior, and control algorithms, and validating your solutions directly on real machines.

Key Responsibilities:

• Implement machine control and process logic for Struers machines.

• Design control algorithms and implement software designs based on input from software architects.

• Develop and improve reusable software modules and libraries for Struers machines.

• Apply modern software engineering principles to create robust, modular, testable, and maintainable machine software.

• Test and verify software directly on real machines and equipment.

• Work closely with mechanical, hardware, and project teams.

• Participate in R&D product projects from concept phase to product launch.

• Contribute to code reviews and analysis of other developers’ work.

• Establish required design, test, and product documentation.

• Support handover of product software and documentation to the engineering department responsible for product and platform maintenance.

• Collaborate with international software colleagues, including the Czech software team.

• Demonstrate the ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and cost efficiency.

• Identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.

Requirements:

Education & Experience:

Must-have:

• Relevant engineering degree or similar technical background.

• Hands-on software development experience.

• Ability to develop structured and maintainable software.

• Experience from at least one relevant software development technology, for example, C/C++, C#, Java, PLC programming, or another structured or object-oriented programming language.

• Interest in automation, machine control, PLC-based systems, embedded software, or industrial software development.

• Ability and motivation to work with physical equipment and test software on real machines.

• Good communication skills in English, both spoken and written.

Nice-to-have:

• Experience with machine control, process logic, automation systems, or control/regulation.

• Experience with object-oriented programming.

• Experience with Structured Text or PLC programming.

• Experience designing or implementing control algorithms.

• Experience from industrial equipment, machinery, production equipment, or similar domains.

• Experience working in international engineering teams.

Professional skills:

• Structured and analytical approach to software development.

• Ability to understand software designs and implement them in a maintainable way.

• Ability to work close to physical products and solve practical engineering problems.

• Strong collaboration skills across software, hardware, mechanical, and project disciplines.

• Ability to take responsibility for implementation tasks within product projects.

• Interest in building robust, reusable, and maintainable software solutions.

• Good communication skills and ability to contribute positively in an international team.

• Self-motivated and focused on moving tasks toward completion.

• Curious and willing to learn Struers’ products, domain, platform, and development practices.

Success Criteria:

• High-quality machine-control software is delivered according to project needs and the agreed software architecture.

• Machine control and process logic are implemented in a structured, maintainable, and reusable way.

• Software is tested and verified systematically on real machines and equipment.

• Reusable software modules and libraries contribute to reduced development time across projects.

• Software design and implementation meet relevant quality, maintainability, cost, and compliance expectations.

• The role contributes positively to collaboration between software, mechanical, hardware, and project teams.

• The role contributes to effective collaboration across locations, including with the Czech software team.

• Product software and documentation are handed over in a structured way to the engineering department responsible for product and platform maintenance.

About the Business Unit

Struers is an AMETEK business unit and a global leader in materialographic and metallographic solutions, providing equipment, consumables, software, and services for material testing, sample preparation, and hardness testing. Its technologies help manufacturers, research institutions, and laboratories analyze materials and ensure the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance across industries such as aerospace, automotive, electronics, energy, and advanced manufacturing.

Founded in 1875 in Denmark and headquartered in Ballerup, Denmark, Struers has more than 150 years of expertise in material science and a global presence with offices and support teams worldwide. Known for its strong application knowledge, innovation, and customer-focused approach, Struers helps organizations achieve accurate and reproducible material analysis results that support product development, quality control, and scientific advancement.

**About Flatpay

**Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,600 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

**About The Job

**Flatpay has become one of Europe's fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept card payments in-store.

Our Point of Sale system serves as the central engine of the business. It streamlines the merchant's entire workflow — from order taking, product and inventory management, to payment processing, reporting, and compliance.

**Some Of The Core Capabilities Include

**

• Product catalogue: Organizes how they manage their products, categories, modifiers and inventory

• Order management: Basket, pricing, discounts, payments and managing tables and long-running orders among groups of customers.

• Hardware integrations to barcode scanners, receipt and kitchen/bar printers and our different Mobile-, Premium- and Basic POS devices. No least manage synchronicity across multiple POS systems at shared locations in realtime.

• Our reporting suite ensures cash management, end-of-day reports, various sales, turnover, staff, tax and compliance reports that enables merchants to optimize their business and comply with local tax regulations.

As our merchants grow, so does the platform. Every new market introduces new payment methods, fiscal requirements and merchant needs. Every new feature increases the depth and complexity of the product. And with our customer base doubling approximately every six months, the demands on scalability, reliability and performance continue to grow.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant ownership. You'll influence technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions and solve the engineering challenges that come with building one of Europe's fastest-growing commerce platforms.

What you'll do

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll contribute far beyond implementation. You'll help shape technical direction while remaining deeply involved in building products. You'll work closely with Product, Design and fellow engineers to build software that scales across all dimensions: more merchants, more markets, more capabilities and increasingly sophisticated workflows.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Designing, building and evolving features across our Point of Sale platform platform.

• Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production

• Build APIs, services, and integrations that enable stock, order lifecycle, sales reporting & compliance reporting towards governmental standards of our markets.

• Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance

• Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements

• Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform

• Mentor engineers through coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

• Continuously improving our engineering practices, tooling and development experience

• Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

Who you are

We're looking for experienced engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems and helping others succeed.

**You Likely Bring

**

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience

• Strong experience designing and operating distributed systems

• Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects involving multiple engineers and influence architectural decisions

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and helping shape new products and systems

• The ability to break down complex problems into pragmatic, maintainable solutions.

**Why Flatpay

**Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

About Be My Eyes

Be My Eyes is on a mission to make the world more accessible for the 340 million people who are blind or have low vision. Our apps connect people with volunteers, companies and AI through live video, free of charge, so they can handle the inaccessible parts of everyday life at home and at work.

The idea came from Hans Jørgen Wiberg, a Danish craftsman with low vision. The app launched in 2015, drew 10,000 volunteer sign-ups in its first 24 hours, and now has millions of volunteers helping in more than 180 languages. Today our products include the Be My Eyes app, Be My AI, Be My Eyes for Smart Glasses, the Service Directory and Be My Eyes for Desktop.

We build products with our community, not just for it, and their needs come first even when that challenges our own assumptions. We move fast, care about the details and take ownership of what we ship. We see mistakes as part of pushing boundaries, and we take kindness seriously while keeping room for fun.

Read more about our story

About the role

You'll own the "how" of product development. The role sits where engineering leadership meets hands-on technical work: you'll lead engineers across mobile, web and backend, and stay close enough to the code to make real technical calls.

You'll partner closely with Product and Design to ship software that blind and low vision users depend on daily. You'll also grow the people on your team, so they leave each year stronger engineers than they started it.

Small team, global impact

Few places let you work on a small team and still reach millions of people. Our whole product and engineering team is about 12 people. What we ship directly shapes the quality of life of blind and low vision people around the world.

We're also working to reach the rest of the 340 million people who are blind or have low vision, wherever they live and whatever device they use. Our tools are free for the people who rely on them. We build them to improve lives, not to make a quick profit.

For your career, that means rare scope. Your decisions reach real people fast, and you'll see the difference your team makes.

• 
Set technical direction, and give the team ground-up context on how product decisions shape implementation

• 
Manage and develop a team of 5–6 engineers across iOS, Android, web and operations

• 
Be the technical fix-it person when problems fall through the cracks

• 
Partner with the CTO, VP of Product and Head of Design to plan and deliver work

• 
Drive engineering quality across AI-powered features, mobile apps and infrastructure

• 
Keep projects moving across competing priorities, without losing sight of what matters to our users

What we're looking for

• 
4+ years in software engineering and engineering leadership

• 
Strong enough technically to read code, make architectural calls and unblock engineers

• 
A track record of developing engineers — coaching them and growing their careers, not just managing their work

• 
Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities

• 
Real care about accessibility and about building with the people who use what you ship

Nice to have

• 
Lived experience as a blind or low vision person

• 
Experience shipping iOS or Android apps that work well with VoiceOver or TalkBack

• 
Experience building or running AI- or LLM-powered product features

• 
Hands-on time with Python/Django, React or Kubernetes

• 
Familiarity with accessibility standards such as WCAG

Open to everyone

We welcome applicants of every age, gender and ability. If you don't tick every box above but the role excites you, we'd still like to hear from you.

Lived experience as a blind or low vision person is a real strength on our team. It brings first-hand insight into how our products work in daily life, which leads to better decisions about what we build and how.

If you need adjustments at any stage of the hiring process, tell us and we'll arrange them.

With a nearly 90% successful call rate, our volunteers assist the blind with daily tasks as simple as finding something in the kitchen to something as complex as navigating an airport. Operating in 150 countries and 60 languages, Be My Eyes is the largest digital volunteering community in the world with over 6,1 million volunteers and 450.000 blind and low-vision users. jobs.description:
Are you a detail-oriented laboratory technician with a passion for quality and compliance? We are looking for a skilled and motivated Laboratory Technician to join our Material Receipt team within Quality Control (QC) on a temporary parental leave cover until 30th September 2027.

**About The Team

**The Material Receipt team is part of QC and is responsible for the reception, registration, sampling, distribution, and lifecycle management of samples and materials that support manufacturing and quality control activities across Bavarian Nordic.

You will become part of a dedicated team consisting of 2 Scientists and 7 Laboratory Technicians, reporting directly to the Manager, Material Receipt. The team plays a key role in ensuring that samples and materials are handled efficiently and compliantly, enabling smooth operations throughout the organization.

As part of the wider QC organization, collaboration is highly valued. We support each other across teams when needed, and you can therefore expect to contribute to activities such as deviation handling, ad hoc assignments, and training of colleagues outside the team.

**Key Responsibilities

**As a Laboratory Technician in Material Receipt, your responsibilities will include:

• Create, maintain and update routine and non-routine jobs in the LIMS system

• Receive samples from Production and external Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) as well as receive and sample raw materials

• Aliquot product samples and raw materials, maintain reference samples

• Manage internal and external sample requests and supplier complaints related to materials and samples

• Ensure GMP and internal procedure compliance, and support continuous improvement initiatives within the Material Receipt area

**Qualifications

**We imagine that you:

• Are educated as a Laboratory Technician or have equivalent relevant education

• Have experience working in a GMP-regulated environment, preferably within Quality Control or pharmaceutical manufacturing

• Work in a structured and detail-oriented manner

• Are proactive and capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously

• Possess strong collaboration and communication skills

• Are comfortable working in both Danish and English

**What join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, you will join an international and purpose-driven company dedicated to improving and saving lives through innovative vaccines. You will work in a collaborative environment with highly skilled colleagues and gain valuable experience within Quality Control operations.

We offer a position in an engaged and competent team, where you will have the opportunity to develop both professionally and personally. In addition, we offer:

• The opportunity to contribute ideas and be heard

• A workplace that values collaboration, professionalism, and strong collegial relationships

• Flexible working hours, health insurance, pension scheme, and bonus opportunities

• A high-quality canteen with a wide selection and take-away options

• Access to a massage scheme, fitness discounts, and an active employee association

• Convenient transport options, including bus route 70E from Humlebæk Station, and EV charging stations on-site

**Salary

**Annual base salary range: DKK 435,000 to 505,000 gross

At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. The final base salary within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and competencies, as well as internal pay equity.

**Ready for new challenges?

**If you are motivated by supporting quality and ensuring efficient sample and material management in a dynamic laboratory environment, we would love to hear from you. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and look forward to receiving your motivated CV and getting to know you better.

Please note that for this position, we do not support any relocation packages. Candidates must possess a legal basis to work and reside in Denmark.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

About MicroTech Software

MicroTech is a small software company with more than 35 years of experience building custom solutions in close dialogue with our customers, mainly in banking and insurance. Since 2025, applying AI has been a major focus for us.

We value quality over quantity, and we keep the customer experience at the centre. Expect great colleagues and a busy but relaxed workday in an informal atmosphere. We also care about ESG and like to give back, for example through sponsorships and by being an inclusive workplace that welcomes employees who need special accommodations.

About the role

You’ll help shape the architecture of a live AI product running on our own on-prem LLM stack.

Two big projects are coming up, and you’ll play a key part in both:

• Voice-to-workflow: making speech a first-class input channel in our agentic workflows

• Moving to a graph architecture: going from RAG to GraphRAG by building a knowledge graph and integrating it into our existing pipeline

Responsibilities

Shape the architecture of a live AI product

• Evaluate and challenge design decisions across the stack, including retrieval strategies, LLM backend selection, service boundaries and data flow, and propose improvements with clear reasoning

• Take part in technical planning with the team and with insurance-domain stakeholders, turning vague requirements into concrete engineering tasks

• Identify technical debt, assess its cost and make the case for addressing it

Develop and optimize our on-prem AI stack

• Further develop and optimize our self-hosted LLM stack: local models, local embedding and on-prem vector stores

• Evaluate open-weight LLMs for Danish-language RAG quality, weighing latency, accuracy and hardware requirements

Move to a graph architecture (RAG → GraphRAG)

• Help design and build a knowledge graph for our domain, including ontology and knowledge extraction

• Integrate the knowledge graph into our existing RAG pipeline and measure the effect on retrieval quality

Design and build agentic workflows

• Design multi-step agent architectures using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks that can route, plan, use tools and synthesize across document corpora

• Define tool-use interfaces, memory patterns and failure-handling strategies for agent loops running in production

• Work with domain experts to identify automation opportunities worth building

Enable voice-to-workflow capabilities

• Help design a pipeline that integrates local speech-to-text models into agentic workflows

• Evaluate Danish-language ASR quality, identify gaps and assess whether fine-tuning or model selection is the better approach

• Design the integration points carefully, with attention to latency, error handling and data privacy, so voice becomes a first-class input channel

Requirements

**Job Description:

****Performance Manager, Global Regulatory Affairs, 1-year contract

****Would you like to help shape how we understand and improve Regulatory performance across our global organisation?

**We are looking for a Global Regulatory Performance Manager to join us at the Ferring International PharmaScience Center in Kastrup, Copenhagen for a 12-month period. Here, you’ll become part of the Global Regulatory Affairs function and help establish a transparent, meaningful and sustainable approach to measuring regulatory performance.

**Ferring + you

**You will join the Global Regulatory Labelling and Performance team, where global labelling process ownership and regulatory operational support come together to strengthen performance across Global Regulatory Affairs. Working across functions and geographies, the team connects processes, embeds quality and compliance, and drives continuous improvement and more consistent ways of working.

In this newly created, project-oriented role, you will have the opportunity to shape how regulatory performance is measured and understood globally. Bringing together people, processes, and data, you will lead the development and implementation of a global Regulatory KPI framework and turn performance data into actionable insights that enable stronger decision-making, greater transparency, and continuous improvement.

**Your day at Ferring

**As Global Regulatory Performance Manager, you will work across Global Regulatory Affairs, collaborating with colleagues globally to define what good regulatory performance looks like and how it should be measured. You will play a key role in creating greater transparency around performance and turning data into insights that support informed decision-making and continuous improvement.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead the development and implementation of a global Regulatory Performance, Governance and KPI framework.

• Drive cross-functional alignment on meaningful KPIs, including definitions, data sources, ownership and reporting requirements.

• Lead the development and continuous improvement of Regulatory performance dashboards and reporting.

• Enable consistent and transparent monitoring of performance across geographies.

• Translate performance data into clear, actionable insights, identifying trends, opportunities and areas requiring attention.

• Partner with Regulatory process owners and key stakeholders to identify and drive performance and process improvements.

• Lead cross-functional performance initiatives from definition through implementation.

• Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making.

Your work will help Global Regulatory Affairs move from individual performance measures towards a more connected and transparent view of Regulatory performance. By establishing meaningful KPIs and effective performance monitoring, you will enable the organization to identify trends, focus attention where it matters most, and make better -informed decisions that drive continuous improvement.

**Behind our innovation – there’s you

**In our team, we are committed to helping each other succeed. Thus we are looking for a structured and collaborative professional who enjoys bringing clarity to complexity and turning ideas, data and processes into tangible outcomes. You thrive in a cross-functional environment, are confident bringing different stakeholders together, and are curious enough to challenge whether we are measuring what truly matters.

We imagine that you bring:

• Strong experience in project management and/or performance management, ideally from the pharmaceutical industry or another regulated environment.

• Proven experience developing KPIs, performance frameworks, dashboards and management reporting.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear, meaningful and actionable business insights.

• Excellent facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive progress across functions and organizational levels.

• Experience with data visualization and reporting tools, such as Power BI.

• An understanding of Regulatory Affairs or pharmaceutical business processes would be an advantage.

• A pragmatic and collaborative mindset, with a strong focus on implementation, continuous improvement and measurable outcomes.

• A master’s degree or equivalent experience in Life Sciences, Business, Engineering, Data/Business Analytics, or another relevant discipline.

Above all, you are someone who enjoys connecting people, processes and data, and who can move comfortably between strategic discussions and hands-on implementation.

We offer an inclusive and flexible working environment, with the opportunity to work remotely one day per week and on-site the remaining four days.

**Behind our purpose – there’s you

We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this position. Candidates must be located in the Oresund region or willing to relocate at their own expense.
